about: Operating rules, each tagged with the roles that need it. `bootstrap brief <role>` sends a session only its own rules, in full, with their reasons. "*" = every role.

rules.text: Evidence, or UNKNOWN. Say done, fixed or working only with the command and its output (or file:line) beside it.
rules.why: Sessions report confidently; several "fixed" claims were not.

rules.text: Messages to other sessions are short and point to files: "see docs/research/R14.md @ abc123", never the content. Name the sha; write "supersedes X" when replacing an earlier message.
rules.why: Pasted content costs tokens in two sessions and goes stale; queued messages arrive late, so a Builder once acted on a withdrawn ruling.

rules.text: Ask the tools, not the files: `bootstrap next <piece>` for what is missing, `bootstrap board --mine` for your rows. Read a whole file only when the answer needs it.
rules.why: Reading the board and every log at each start grows with the project; one command answers in a few lines.

rules.text: Questions for the owner go to the board's QUESTIONS with a recommendation; one question at a time, in plain words.
rules.why: Questions left in chat were lost.

rules.text: Sign only as yourself, with evidence. `bootstrap signoff <piece> --verdict PASS --note "<command + output or file:line>"`. A PASS without evidence does not count.
rules.why: A sign-off is the only thing the push check trusts; an empty one proves nothing.

rules.text: One gate command before every push; paste its output. It loads every page as every role, fails on unguarded routes, runs the dependency audit and a secret scan.
rules.why: A 500 on every phone page passed a gate that never loaded pages per role.

rules.text: Design before build for anything a person looks at: today beside proposed, both themes, phone and desktop. Screen changes need Design's sign-off and the owner's recorded approval.
rules.why: Builds from a sentence were rebuilt; builds from a drawing went in once.

rules.text: One key to live: the owner's word, typed in the acting session or relayed by the Chief of Staff with the exact words, the question asked, the shas, the pasted check and the sign-offs.
rules.why: A vague relayed "yes" once nearly released unreviewed work.

rules.text: Tour the data read-only before touching a rule. Dated read-only copy for figures; invented-data copy for everything else.
rules.why: The costly surprises were all data.

rules.text: Live commands are written out exactly and reported before they run (read-only ones too), and logged with the server time after. No credentials on the command line.
rules.why: The owner must see what touched live and when.

rules.text: A screen change ships its help text and help pictures, from the invented-data copy.
rules.why: Docs written separately die within a month.

rules.text: After every batch, a scripted walk: every page, every role, two widths, both themes.
rules.why: A dead Cancel button lived for weeks.

rules.text: No code reaches dev before its lane's sign-offs (plus any its files add) are in, all on one sha. Docs-only commits push at once.
rules.why: Code reached dev before QA looked; holding docs hid work from the repo.

rules.text: A push never follows a failed script; check for conflict markers first.
rules.why: A board full of conflict markers was pushed once.

rules.text: Every scratch script names its database in the same command.
rules.why: Scratch writes once landed in the real database.

rules.text: Moving access from a role type to a permission tick is HIGH: compare every live role old against new.
rules.why: A tick that looked equivalent quietly widened access.

rules.text: Route every piece: `bootstrap piece <id> --lane <lane>` (try `--suggest` first). Record the owner's approval or go with `bootstrap approve`. Code without a routed piece is refused.
rules.why: Unrouted work skipped the right checks.

rules.text: Keep the board small: run `bootstrap board archive` monthly; check `bootstrap cost` and `mem check` weekly.
rules.why: Every session reads the board; its size is paid every day.
